sources_considered.why: An IDC researcher reports an adoption-cost survey. Its October 2024 observations and broad cost definition prevent decisive use.
Reports price-related model selection, but describes January 2024 and also identifies speed as a reason.
Discusses adoption costs and bundled application pricing without identifying a deployment blocked by LLM-provider prices.

evidence_items.publisher: IDC research manager Mona Liddell, writing in CIO
evidence_items.explanation: The survey establishes reported adoption-cost concerns before the post. It neither isolates model-provider pricing nor measures January 2025 decisions.

This is reputable reporting of earlier price-sensitive model selection, used because no underlying customer records were supplied. Switching models is not necessarily a blocked deployment, and the period predates the claim.

unresolved_gaps: No verified January 2025 deployment decision was located that isolates model-provider pricing as the blocking factor.
The available survey combines broader adoption costs.
The prevalence of genuinely price-blocked companies or use cases is not established.
